payload.core_mechanism_summary: Count frequencies of each row pattern; the maximum frequency is the answer because sweeping columns toggles bits uniformly, so only identical rows can become all-clean together.
payload.rationale: The solution counts occurrences of each binary string row. Since column sweeps flip the same bits in every row, two rows can become all clean only if they start identical. Thus the maximum number of clean rows equals the maximum frequency of any row pattern. This is a greedy selection of the most frequent pattern, proven by an exchange argument.
